arguments.text: Good start. Settle now to steady race effort, long way to go.

6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: near-even effort at about sustainable shaft power (~195-200 W pod, boat CP 131 W) so the pod reserve reaches near zero only at the finish. Start was hot (255 W pod at 1 min, reserve 73%). Ease to settle, then hold. Compare out vs back legs for current. Final sprint (finish) from about 400-500 m to go if reserve allows. Watch for incidents: rudder weed (speed drops at same power), wind shift, pod drift, radio course changes.

arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (odd legs north into ~0.15 m/s push, even legs south helped ~0.15). Start was hot; paddler settled at ~200 W pod. CP corrected at min 10.3 to pod 202 W / boat 139 W (reserve model had read 0 for 3 min with no forced slowdown, effort 7/10). Plan: hold ~200-207 W pod (their own steady effort) through legs 3-5, no pace targets that ignore current. Use reserve readings from the corrected model; if pod power fades below ~190 at steady rate or paddler says 9+, ease. Final sprint (finish) from ~500 m to go if pod reserve > 15 %, else ~300 m. Weed on rudder happened once (min 8, cleared with clear_rudder): if push_local drops ~0.1 below push_along at steady pod power, clear again.

Min 10.4: paddler 7/10 hard but holding. Legs: leg1 out 225 W pod 3.25 GPS; leg2 back 202 W 3.38 GPS (incl weed). Set CP pod 202 / boat 139 (1 of 3 uses): pod reserve now 39 %, boat 44 %. If reserve drains toward 0 again without slowdown, CP still low; if paddler slows hard, CP set too high.

Reverting, reserve slightly larger since the blow-up came a little late.

arguments.text: RACE 7000 m (radio min 14.3 added a leg; distance set, paddler told). Legs of 1000 m: odd legs north into ~0.15 m/s push, even legs south helped ~0.15; finish at end of leg 7 (north). POD UNRELIABLE from ~min 15: reads ~20 % high against boat power (boat/pod 0.56 vs 0.69 early) - judge effort from boat power, speed through water, fade and the paddler, not pod numbers. CP back to original boat 131 W, reserve set 11 kJ at min 17 (paddler blew up ~min 15, consistent with boat model). Plan: hold boat power ~130-135 W (speed through water ~3.2) on legs 4-6, no pushing; avoid a second blow-up. Weed seen at min 8 (cleared) and suspected min 15 (clear_rudder asked twice): if fade drops to ~-10 % at steady rate, clear again. Final sprint (finish) from ~400 m to go if boat reserve > 25 %, else ~250 m.

Min 17: paddler 9/10 close to limit. Speed through water recovered to 3.26 and fade back to -3.6 % (drag maybe gone or masked). Pod 247 W vs boat 138 W. Reverted CP (2 of 3 uses): boat 131 W / 11 kJ, pod 190 W; boat reserve now 21 %, pod 0 % (ignore pod). Next: cue hold steady, no push.

arguments.text: Min 18.3: escort radio: wind filling from the SOUTH 8-12 kt. Headwind on south legs (4, 6), tailwind on north legs (5, 7 = finish leg); it roughly cancels the ~0.15 current. push_along lags, so boat-model power/reserve/fade will read LOW on south legs and HIGH on north legs: do not cue ease/push off those alone. Pod has plateaued ~248 W (about 1.26x its early gain; real ~197 W) - usable only for relative changes. Cued hold at 17.8 (boat 134 W).

RACE 7000 m (radio min 14.3 added a leg). Legs of 1000 m: odd legs north, even legs south; finish at end of leg 7 (north). Current ~0.15 m/s pushes south. From min 18.3 escort says wind filling from the SOUTH 8-12 kt: headwind on south legs 4 and 6, tailwind on north legs 5 and 7; the boat-model numbers (power, reserve, fade, sustainable pace) will mislead until push re-fits (low on south legs, high on north). POD reads ~25 % high since ~min 15 (plateau ~248 W ~ real 197): use only for relative change. CP: boat 131 W / 11 kJ (reverted min 17). Paddler blew up ~min 15, recovered, 9/10 at min 17. Plan: steady effort at about current feel; slightly firmer into the headwind (south legs), no extra on tailwind legs. Final sprint (finish) from ~400 m to go (on leg 7, tailwind) if paddler not at 10/10, else ~250 m. Weed seen min 8 (cleared): if speed drops suddenly at steady pod reading, clear_rudder.

arguments.text: RACE 7000 m. Legs of 1000 m: odd legs north, even south; finish at end of leg 7 (north). Current ~0.15 m/s pushes south; wind from the SOUTH since min 18 (headwind south legs, tailwind north legs). INSTRUMENTS: pod reads ~25 % high since ~min 15 (relative changes only); boat-model power/reserve confounded by the wind; neither reserve number is trustworthy. Paddler BLEW UP TWICE: min ~15 and min ~23 (race s 1380), both after holding pod ~248 / boat ~135. True sustainable effort is lower: after recovering, hold ~5-8 % below that (pod ~230-235, GPS ~3.10 north / ~3.18 south), re-cue ease/hold every 2-3 min because their own pacing creeps back up. Final sprint (finish) only for the last ~250-300 m, and only if they are not 10/10. If speed drops suddenly at steady pod reading, think weed (clear_rudder).
